A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''officer''' was stationed on a [[pleasure cruiser]] commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quasar (Human)|Quasar]] before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When four [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of the [[Merson pirates/Legends|Merson pirates]] were spotted, Quasar sent the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] to retrieve [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the bridge to take command, since Quasar, along with the officers and the crew, lacked combat experience. Thanks to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Merson ships were destroyed, saving everyone on board.
